{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.42

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns [[true]] if given unit is turned out, otherwise [[false]]. The output changes to [[true]] after unit finished turning out, however will change to [[false]] almost immediately after unit is ordered to turn in.

|s1= [[isTurnedOut]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - unit on turn(in/out) enabled turret
|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>_commanderOut = isTurnedOut (tank turretUnit [0,0]);</sqf>

|seealso= [[moveOut]] [[moveInDriver]] [[turretUnit]]
}}
